headline: Prime ESE angle but only knee-high, and onshore by mid-morning.
today: The direction is exactly what we want — ESE at 121, prime — but there's just 1.3ft of it and the wind is onshore from the jump, building to 14mph SE by afternoon. Your window is the dawn patrol before the S wind fills in; it's small and soft, so it's a log or nothing. Best around the 7:48 high with a bit of push.

daysToWatch.note: The home-break pick of the week. Glassy dawn and morning (2-4mph), swell up to 2.2ft at a good SE angle. Longboard the morning session before the afternoon S onshore returns.
N offshore all morning keeps it clean, but only 1.5-1.7ft at short period. Fun little groveler or log session early, nothing to rearrange your day for.
